new_issues: The patched begin(bool initialState = LOW) incorrectly handles the case when initialState is false (LOW). The original begin(false) would set _buttonState to false, but the patch only sets _buttonState when initialState != LOW, so _buttonState remains unchanged. This changes the observable behavior for callers that explicitly pass false as the initial state.

The patch introduces a dependency on the Arduino environment by using Serial.println and NUM_DIGITAL_PINS. If the code is compiled outside of an Arduino context, these symbols may be undefined, leading to compilation errors.
